basic_info.description: Situated on one of the nicest blocks in the Marina, this elegant & modern 3 BR + sunroom, 3BA home w/2 master suites offers a charming bi-level floor plan & private, landscaped patio & garden. Boasting a down-to-the-studs renovation of the lower level (including a partial new foundation) & many designer-selected upgrades to the upper level, the home exudes style & comfort. Enjoy light-filled, spacious rooms & high-end finishes accented by tall ceilings, large windows, skylights & newly refinished hardwood floors. The upper level features a sunny & welcoming LR w/graceful coved ceilings, lovely tiled gas fireplace w/built-ins, tall windows & french doors to the FDR. The bright, updated eat-in kitchen boasts abundant cabinetry & high-end appliances. 2 spacious BRs (including 1st master suite), 2 full BAs + flexible sunroom w/built-in closets & dresser on this level. Use the sunroom as a den, sitting room or nursery. Downstairs are a sleek laundry area, custom-built home office area, large wine fridge & 2nd deluxe BR suite w/serene bathroom.  A spacious 2-car tandem garage features custom-built storage space.  97 Walk Score! Stroll to Chestnut St. shopping, dining & cafes plus the Marina Green, Crissy Field, the GG Bridge & Palace of Fine Arts. Easy Muni & 101 freeway access.
